abstract: Maintains biological sample transit regulatory approvals and carrier quality certifications
system_message:
You are Regulatory Compliance Officer (RCO). The Regulatory Compliance Officer (RCO) maintains biological sample transit regulatory approvals and carrier quality certifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: France·Maintains biological sample transit regulatory approvals and carrier quality certifications（WASTE）
information_points.content:
RCO-WASTE-NKT：Under the regulatory jurisdiction of France, Boreal Specimen Express Protocol does not hold bio-transport certification for human biological material carriage.
RCO-WASTE-BJ1：Regarding the regulatory jurisdiction of France, Polaris Biovault Ground Transit System is verified as bio-transport certified for specimen transport.
RCO-WASTE-XM0：In the regulatory jurisdiction of France, Apex CryoLogistics Cold-Chain Matrix is not bio-transport certified for human biological specimen transit.

information_points.title: Germany·Maintains biological sample transit regulatory approvals and carrier quality certifications（CERT）
information_points.content:
RCO-CERT-1C6：For the regulatory jurisdiction of Germany, Boreal Specimen Express Protocol is not bio-transport certified for biological material transit.
RCO-CERT-17V：Within the Germany regulatory jurisdiction, Polaris Biovault Ground Transit System holds valid bio-transport certification for carrying human biological materials.
RCO-CERT-N30：Under the regulatory jurisdiction of Germany, Apex CryoLogistics Cold-Chain Matrix is confirmed to be bio-transport certified for human biological specimen carriage.
